# Architecture Documentation for MapleSure Member Sign-In

## Overview
MapleSure Member Sign-In is a standalone online sign-in system designed for MapleSure members. It enables members to securely sign in to their accounts to access various services and manage their insurance policies. The application is yet to be developed and will be built using a robust technology stack.

## Technology Stack
- **Java**: A versatile programming language providing the core foundation of the application logic.
- **Spring Boot**: A framework for building Java applications, offering simplicity in setup and rapid development features.
- **HTML**: The standard markup language used to create the front-end structure of the application.
- **CSS**: A style sheet language used to describe the presentation of the HTML structure.
- **JavaScript**: A scripting language to implement interactive and dynamic features on the web application.

## What This Application Does NOT Do
- The application is currently in its conception stage and has no code written or components developed yet. This documentation serves as a foundational blueprint for future development.
- As a sign-in system, it does not handle registration processes or password recovery mechanisms at this stage.

## Application Components
Currently, there are no developed components. This section will be updated as components are defined and built during the development phase.

## Data Management
No data is managed or processed at this stage of development. Future versions will detail how data is stored, accessed, and secured.

## Security
Specific security practices and protocols will be outlined and implemented in future stages of development to ensure member data protection and compliance with industry standards.

## Conclusion
This document establishes the initial plan for the MapleSure Member Sign-In system, setting the stage for a secure and efficient method for members to access MapleSure services.

## Introduction
